newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Surgical hit with $20.5 mln damages.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Surgical hit with $20.5 mln damages.

text.p: U.S. Surgical Corp said Thursday a federal judge has awarded $20.5 million in damages to Applied Medical Resources in a patent infringement suit.
Applied Medical's suit said U.S. Surgical's trocar products infringed Applied Medical's patent.
U.S. Surgical "will appeal the decision, which the company believes is totally unsupported by the evidence," company chairman Leon Hirsch said in a written statement.
U.S. Surgical will reserve the full amount of the award, plus expenses, pending the outcome of the appeal, it said.
U.S. Surgical said there has been no interruption in product delivery because of ample inventory at distributors, and it has begun production of a new product outside the scope of the court's ruling.
